messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: p99 streaming latency spike detected on /v1/stream (generation). Multiple tenants reporting stalls and SLO breaches. p95 jumped from ~140ms to ~600ms, p99 from ~800ms to ~6s. Auto-escalation to infra-oncall.

maya: i'm oncall, looking — seeing a lot of streaming stalls in the metrics dashboard. p99 tokens emitted show big gaps around the tokenization/kvcache path.

raj: stacktrace-ish traces show GC/memory backpressure? also KV cache miss rate spiked from 0.8% -> 22% in the last 6m.

sre-liz: NVML alerts: ECC correctable errors ramping on node gpu-ward-17. Thermal sensors are trending up (gpu temp 87C). Correctable errors count: 120 in 5m. Throttle state changed to 1.

eng-ml-kevin: model-serving queue depth on pool dedicated-3 is spiking. streaming sessions pile up waiting for first response — looks like stalls at token emission (streams start then pause).

maya: can someone paste the node health logs?

raj: grabbing kube and nvml logs:
```
$ kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-ward-17
pod/model-serving-abc   2/2 CrashLoopBackOff  gpu-ward-17
pod/model-serving-def   1/2 Running           gpu-ward-17
```
nvml: ECC_CORRECTABLE_COUNTER = 120 (5m), THERMAL_THROTTLE = 1, POWER_THROTTLE = 0\n```

sre-liz: also finding repeated "page migration failed" entries in dmesg around the same timestamps. Could be memory bus flakiness under load.

maya: i'm going to isolate gpu-ward-17 to stop accepting new streams and drain existing pods off it.

maya: running:
```
kubectl cordon node/gpu-ward-17
kubectl drain node/gpu-ward-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=10m
```

incident-bot: Routing policy applied: fallback to model-quantized-small at 20% per circuit-breaker rule.

eng-runtime: bump fallback to 50% to reduce queue growth while we drain — model-quantized-small has higher latency but keeps throughput.

maya: bumped to 50%. monitoring queue and p99.

support-amy: which customers impacted? PMs asking. I see increased error rates for tenants: alpha_co, beta_inc, prod-ml. ~12 tenants show >3x p99 increase, 4 tenants saw 502/timeout errors.

maya: contacting account owners for top 3. will put status update in customer-status board.

raj: observed that restarting the serving process on healthy nodes reduces local stall rates for sessions moved off the faulty node. recommend rolling restart excluding gpu-ward-17.

eng-runtime: performing rolling restart on pool dedicated-3 (excluding node marked unschedulable). command: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-serving -n inference --field-selector=spec.nodeName!=gpu-ward-17`

sre-liz: hardware note — ECC correctable is high but correctable. still suggests the GPU is degrading and could flip to uncorrectable. vendor replacement recommended.

infra-bot: Raised INF-4521: "gpu-ward-17 suspected ECC/thermal degradation — replace node". Priority=P0. Ticket link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4521

eng-ml-kevin: logs from runtime show repeated messages: "stall: allocation waiting for migration" and "failed to map nvml memory" around the same spikes. likely memory subsystem issue on that GPU.

maya: mitigation summary so far:
- isolated and cordoned gpu-ward-17
- drained pods off the node
- increased fallback routing to 50%
- rolling restart of model-serving deployment on other nodes
- raised replacement ticket and notified hardware team
- informed support to message impacted customers

incident-bot: Automated metrics: after mitigation p95 dropped to ~220ms, p99 to ~1.1s (was 6s). Error rates returned to baseline for most tenants.

support-amy: posting a customer-facing note now. will follow up with account teams for the 4 customers who saw errors.

raj: follow-up actions:
- add alert for ECC correctable rate > 50 in 5m for any GPU node (current threshold too high) — owner: eng-infra (raj)
- add an automated traffic-shift runbook entry to move to fallback-small at 50% when p99>1s (owner: eng-runtime)
- add postmortem item: quantify how much reserve capacity we need for absorbed failover (owner: product infra)

maya: i'm marking this handed to infra/hardware for replacement and to eng-runtime for follow-up. i'll keep incident channel open for postmortem notes. thanks all. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Assigned INF-4521 to hardware-oncall. Estimated ETA for hot-swap: 3h.

eng-ml-kevin: note for post-incident: add an end-to-end synthetic streaming user test that exercises KV cache hot-paths at scale — caught this earlier in canary would have reduced impact.

maya: accepted. creating follow-up task: RT-987: streaming synthetic tests + canary checks.

incident-bot: Incident closed for active mitigation. Post-incident meeting scheduled: tomorrow 15:00 UTC.

maya: final — please include exact nvml dumps and dmesg excerpts in the RCA.

sre-liz: will attach logs and hardware telemetry to INF-4521.

support-amy: customer comms sent. will link updates in the ticket.

maya: thanks team, good mitigation. we avoided long-term outage, but need RCA and improved alerts.
